answer: Audits are published in tundra, queued in cipher, and yarrow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 66 identities per epoch. A farm of 226 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 682 identities would post 2332 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
